risks.title: Significant pension and post-retirement obligations
risks.score_rationale: Unfunded obligations of $469.2 million. Actuarial assumptions (discount rates, asset returns) have significant impact on liabilities and costs, with sensitivities of several million dollars.

risks.title: Litigation and contingency risk
risks.score_rationale: Final settlement payment of $60.6 million for Keystone litigation in 2025. References to various legal proceedings and indemnifications indicate persistent risk of significant financial settlements.

risks.title: Working capital management and liquidity
risks.score_rationale: Operating cash flow of $1,784.4 million in 2025, down $125.9 million from 2024. Cash equivalents decreased by $69.8 million (from $969.3 to $896.5 million).

risks.title: Capital investments and acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Significant 2025 investments including Fevertree Drinks plc ($88.1 million) and acquisition of Fevertree USA, Inc. Investing cash flows used totaled $822.1 million.

risks.title: Compliance with debt covenants
risks.score_rationale: Covenants tied to revolving credit facility (financial leverage, collateral, mergers). Company is currently in compliance, but future non-compliance could have consequences.

risks.title: Interest rate and foreign exchange volatility
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to interest rate and FX fluctuations through significant debt obligations and multi-currency credit facilities. 2025 currency impact: net favorable impact of $77.6 million on sales, but unfavorable impact of $50.1 million on COGS.

risks.title: Tariff impacts and commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Tariff announcements in Q2 2025 triggered spike in Midwest premium (aluminum premium). Estimated impact of $35 million in 2025 with continuation expected. Hedging is costly due to lack of liquidity and tariff transparency.
